title: Shortest window over quota
description:
A customer is billed extra whenever usage over some stretch of consecutive days reaches a quota. They want to know the shortest stretch that ever did.

Write `shortest_over_quota(usage, quota)` where `usage` is a list of positive integers. Return the length of the shortest contiguous run whose sum is **at least** `quota`, or `0` if no run reaches it.

**Example**

```
shortest_over_quota([2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 3], 7)
# 2   ([4, 3])
```
hints: Grow the window on the right until its sum reaches the quota.
Once it does, shrink from the left as far as you can while the sum still meets the quota, recording the length each time.
This works because every value is positive: removing a value always lowers the sum.
